question: As of July 2025, which of the following public sector enterprise is awarded with "Maharatna" status?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Power Finance Corporation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Power Finance Corporation (PFC)** was accorded the prestigious **"Maharatna"** status by the Government of India in **July 2025**. This recognition elevates PFC's position among India's top public sector enterprises.
 
• **Maharatna status** is granted to select Central Public Sector Enterprises (CPSEs) that demonstrate consistent financial performance, global competitiveness, and significant contributions to the Indian economy.
 
• PFC is a leading financial institution in the power sector, providing **financial assistance to various electricity generation, transmission, and distribution projects** across India.
 
• With the Maharatna status, PFC now enjoys increased autonomy in investment and decision-making. It can make investments of up to **Rs. 5,000 crores** or 15% of its net worth in a single project, without requiring government approval.
 
• PFC's stellar financial performance, including its consistent **profitability, net worth, and operational efficiency**, were key factors in achieving this status.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Maharatna Status Criteria:**

 
 
• A CPSE must have an average annual turnover of more than **Rs. 25,000 crores**, a net worth of over **Rs. 15,000 crores**, and net profit of over **Rs. 5,000 crores** during the last three years.
 
• It must also have a global presence and significant international operations.
 
 
 
• **Benefits of Maharatna Status:**
 
 
• Increased financial and operational autonomy, allowing CPSEs to make larger investments without seeking governmental approval.
 
• Enhanced decision-making capabilities to compete globally and expand operations.
 
 
 
• **About Power Finance Corporation (PFC):**
 
 
• Established in **1986**, PFC is a **Navratna CPSE** under the Ministry of Power, Government of India.
 
• PFC provides **financial assistance to power sector projects** across the generation, transmission, and distribution segments.
 
• It plays a vital role in supporting India's energy goals, including the government's initiatives on renewable energy and rural electrification.
 
 
 
• **Other Public Sector Enterprises with Maharatna Status:**
 
 
• Some other companies holding Maharatna status include **Indian Oil Corporation (IOCL)**, **Coal India Limited (CIL)**, **Steel Authority of India Limited (SAIL)**, and **Oil and Natural Gas Corporation (ONGC)**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL):**

 
 
• It is a Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Defence, specializing in **defense electronics and communication equipment**.
 
• BEL has not yet achieved Maharatna status as of July 2025.
 
 
 
• **Engineers India Limited (EIL):**
 
 
• It is a Navratna company providing engineering consultancy and EPC (Engineering, Procurement, and Construction) services.
 
• EIL is recognized as a Navratna but has not attained Maharatna status.
 
 
 
• **Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL):**
 
 
• RVNL is a Miniratna company under the Ministry of Railways, engaged in the implementation of railway infrastructure projects.
 
• It does not meet the criteria for Maharatna status as of now.
